text: IRに関するお問い合わせ (IR Inquiry Form) IRに関するお問い合わせ (IR Inquiry Form) こちらは日本瓦斯株式会社のIRに関するお問い合わせフォームです。 お問い合わせいただいた内容については、弊社IR担当者より返信させていただきます。 【お問い合わせいただく前のご確認】 ①よくあるご質問 皆さまからよくお問い合わせいただく質問を「よくあるご質問」にまとめておりますので、ぜひご一読ください。 よくあるご質問：https://www.nichigas.co.jp/ir/individual-investor/investorsfaqs ②ご返信について 土日、祝日にいただいたお問い合わせについては、翌営業日以降に回答させていただきます。予めご了承ください。 ③ 送信完了後の確認メールについて お問い合わせ完了後、ご入力いただいたメールアドレスへ内容の控え（自動返信）をお送りいたします。 万が一届かない場合、メールアドレスの間違いや「迷惑メールフォルダ」に入っている可能性がございます。ご確認のうえ、届いていない場合は大変お手数ですが再度送信をお願いいたします。 This is Nippon Gas Co., Ltd. Investor Relations (IR) inquiry form. Our IR representative will get back to you regarding your inquiry. Before you contact us 1. Investor FAQs Please check our "Investor FAQs" first, which list answers to most commonly asked questions. If you are unable to find the answer, please feel free to make an inquiry here. Investor FAQs: https://www.nichigas.co.jp/en/ir/individual-investor/investorsfaqs 2. Response to your inquiry form (Business Days) Please note that any inquiries received on weekends and holidays will be answered on the next business day or later. 3. Confirmation email An automated confirmation email will be sent to the email address provided once your inquiry is submitted. If you do not receive it, please check if your email address was entered correctly or check your spam folder. If you still have not received it, we would appreciate it if you could resend your inquiry form. Note: - Fields marked with an red asterisk (*) are required - Please provide your e-mail address (メールアドレス) below in order to receive confirmation email and for us to reach back to you Sign in to Google to save your progress. We will not disclose or provide acquired personal information to any third party, other than our group affiliated companies and legal professionals such as lawyers who are under a statutory duty of confidentiality, unless we have your consent or based on laws and regulations. Please refer to the following website for further information regarding the "Personal Information Protection Policy": https://www.nichigas.co.jp/en/privacy . If you agree to the “Consent to the Handling of Personal Information,” please check the box and then click the submit button (送信) in order to submit this form. * 上記の個人情報保護方針に同意します。(I agree to the above Personal Information Protection Policy.)
